```{r packages, cache=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(survRM2)
library(scales)
```

```{r setup}
# Shared cohort dates (all _2022 organs; informational)
c1_start <- as.Date("2019-08-01")
c1_end   <- as.Date("2021-07-31")
c2_start <- as.Date("2022-08-01")
c2_end   <- as.Date("2024-07-31")

# Use the SAME inputs as survival_benefit_<organ>_2022.Rmd so the combined
# figures agree with each per-organ report:
#   * Per-capita 1-year RMSTs (waitlist, recipient, benefit) are computed on the
#     1:1 propensity-score MATCHED cohorts (matched_<organ>.rds).
#   * Aggregate benefit scales the matched per-capita benefit by the number
#     transplanted in the ELIGIBLE cohort (cohort_<organ>.rds), i.e.
#     n_tx <- sum(cohort$transplanted), exactly as each organ file does.
# Both RDS sets are rebuilt by data_prep.Rmd and carry a `cohort` column with
# values "Pre-Policy" / "Post-Policy".
organs <- c(Heart = "heart", Kidney = "kidney", Liver = "liver", Lung = "lung")

organ_matched  <- lapply(organs, function(o) readRDS(paste0("matched_", o, ".rds")))
organ_eligible <- lapply(organs, function(o) readRDS(paste0("cohort_",  o, ".rds")))

cohort_vals <- c("Pre-Policy" = "#374E55", "Post-Policy" = "#DF8F44")
```

```{r prep_data, dependson="setup"}
organ_names  <- names(organ_matched)
organ_levels <- c("Heart", "Kidney", "Liver", "Lung")

# Per-capita 1-year RMST on the matched cohort for one organ + policy period.
# Returns the rmst2() object, or NULL if an arm is too small / rmst2() fails
# (same >=10-per-arm guard the organ files rely on).
matched_rmst <- function(org, coh) {
  m <- organ_matched[[org]] %>% filter(cohort == coh, follow_days_1y > 0)
  if (sum(m$transplanted) < 10 || sum(m$transplanted == 0) < 10) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(rmst2(m$follow_days_1y, m$dead_1y, m$transplanted, tau = 365),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Number transplanted in the ELIGIBLE cohort — the aggregate-benefit multiplier
# (matches n_tx <- sum(cohort1$transplanted) in the organ files).
elig_n_tx <- function(org, coh) {
  e <- organ_eligible[[org]]
  sum(e$transplanted[e$cohort == coh])
}

as_organ_factors <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    organ  = factor(organ,  levels = organ_levels),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Pre-Policy", "Post-Policy"))
  )
}
```

```{r tx_count_bar, dependson="prep_data", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# Number of transplants among ELIGIBLE candidates listed in each window —
# sum(transplanted) in cohort_<organ>.rds. This is the same n_tx that scales the
# aggregate benefit below and that each organ file reports, so the bars are
# consistent across all three views (count, per-capita benefit, aggregate).
tx_count_forest <- bind_rows(lapply(organ_names, function(org) {
  tibble(organ  = org,
         cohort = c("Pre-Policy", "Post-Policy"),
         est    = c(elig_n_tx(org, "Pre-Policy"), elig_n_tx(org, "Post-Policy")))
})) %>%
  as_organ_factors()

ggplot(tx_count_forest, aes(x = organ, y = est, fill = cohort,
                            group = interaction(organ, cohort))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_vals, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of Transplants") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r waitlist_bar, dependson="prep_data", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# 1-year waitlist RMST (arm=0, never-transplanted) by organ and cohort,
# from the matched cohorts.
waitlist_forest <- bind_rows(lapply(organ_names, function(org) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("Pre-Policy", "Post-Policy"), function(coh) {
    r <- matched_rmst(org, coh); if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    wl <- r$RMST.arm0$rmst
    tibble(organ = org, cohort = coh,
           est = unname(wl["Est."]),
           lo  = unname(wl["lower .95"]),
           hi  = unname(wl["upper .95"]))
  }))
})) %>%
  as_organ_factors()

ggplot(waitlist_forest, aes(x = organ, y = est, fill = cohort,
                            group = interaction(organ, cohort))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.2, lwd = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_vals, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "1-year RMST (days)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r benefit_bar, dependson="prep_data", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# Average (per-capita) 1-year survival benefit = RMST(arm=1) - RMST(arm=0)
# on the matched cohorts.
benefit_forest <- bind_rows(lapply(organ_names, function(org) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("Pre-Policy", "Post-Policy"), function(coh) {
    r <- matched_rmst(org, coh); if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    drow <- r$unadjusted.result["RMST (arm=1)-(arm=0)", ]
    tibble(organ = org, cohort = coh,
           est = unname(drow["Est."]),
           lo  = unname(drow["lower .95"]),
           hi  = unname(drow["upper .95"]))
  }))
})) %>%
  as_organ_factors()

ggplot(benefit_forest, aes(x = organ, y = est, fill = cohort,
                            group = interaction(organ, cohort))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.2, lwd = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_vals, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average survival benefit (days)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r aggregate_bar, dependson="prep_data", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# Aggregate 1-year survival benefit (days) = matched per-capita benefit x the
# number transplanted in the eligible cohort, matching each organ file's
# agg_days <- n_tx * benefit (n_tx <- sum(cohort$transplanted)).
agg_forest <- bind_rows(lapply(organ_names, function(org) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("Pre-Policy", "Post-Policy"), function(coh) {
    r <- matched_rmst(org, coh); if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    drow <- r$unadjusted.result["RMST (arm=1)-(arm=0)", ]
    n_tx <- elig_n_tx(org, coh)
    tibble(organ = org, cohort = coh,
           est = unname(n_tx * drow["Est."]),
           lo  = unname(n_tx * drow["lower .95"]),
           hi  = unname(n_tx * drow["upper .95"]))
  }))
})) %>%
  as_organ_factors()

ggplot(agg_forest, aes(x = organ, y = est, fill = cohort,
                            group = interaction(organ, cohort))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.2, lwd = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_vals, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Aggregate survival benefit (days)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r aggregate_bar_years, dependson="aggregate_bar", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# Aggregate survival benefit in life-years (days / 365.25).
agg_forest_years <- agg_forest %>%
  mutate(est = est / 365.25, lo = lo / 365.25, hi = hi / 365.25)

ggplot(agg_forest_years, aes(x = organ, y = est, fill = cohort,
```
